title: table
description: A table; each cell is a line of Markdown (code, bold, links), a number in quotes as it is drawn, a word of its column's pills, drawn as that pill, or a pill

items.description: Its title, a line of Markdown; or { title, num, pills } for a column holding more than its title

num.description: Numbers: aligned right, in a fixed-width font

pills.description: Words drawn as pills in this column, each with its tone: a cell that is one of them, whole, as { 'Done': good }

rows.description: Rows of cells, as many as the columns
